n, m, modulus = map(int, input().split())

MAX_SIZE = 500
comb = [[0] * (MAX_SIZE + 1) for _ in range(MAX_SIZE + 1)]
dp1_state_first = [0] * (MAX_SIZE + 1)
dp1_state_second = [0] * (MAX_SIZE + 1)
dp2_state_first = [[[0] * (MAX_SIZE + 1) for _ in range(MAX_SIZE + 1)] for _ in range(2)]
dp2_state_second = [[[0] * (MAX_SIZE + 1) for _ in range(MAX_SIZE + 1)] for _ in range(2)]

def add_mod(x, y):
    x += y
    if x >= modulus:
        x -= modulus
    return x

def sum_series(n):
    return n * (n + 1) // 2

# Compute binomial coefficients
for i in range(m + 1):
    comb[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        comb[i][j] = add_mod(comb[i][j], comb[i - 1][j])
        comb[i][j] = add_mod(comb[i][j], comb[i - 1][j - 1])

# Initialize dp1_state
dp1_state_first[0] = 1
for i in range(1, m + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        w = (dp1_state_first[j - 1] * dp1_state_first[i - j]) % modulus
        w = (w * comb[i - 1][j - 1]) % modulus
        temp_second = 0
        temp_second = add_mod(temp_second, (sum_series(j - 1) + sum_series(i - j)) * w % modulus)
        temp_second = add_mod(temp_second, (dp1_state_second[j - 1] * dp1_state_first[i - j]) % modulus * (i + 1) % modulus * comb[i - 1][j - 1])
        temp_second = add_mod(temp_second, (dp1_state_first[j - 1] * dp1_state_second[i - j]) % modulus * (i + 1) % modulus * comb[i - 1][j - 1])
        dp1_state_first[i] = add_mod(dp1_state_first[i], w * (i + 1) % modulus)
        dp1_state_second[i] = add_mod(dp1_state_second[i], temp_second)

# Initialize dp2_state
dp2_state_first[0][0] = 1
dp2_state_first[1][0] = 1

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i + 1):
        for ln in range(1, n - i + 1):
            # Update dp2_state[1]
            dp2_state_first[1][i + ln][j] = add_mod(dp2_state_first[1][i + ln][j], dp2_state_first[0][i][j])
            dp2_state_second[1][i + ln][j] = add_mod(dp2_state_second[1][i + ln][j], dp2_state_second[0][i][j])
            # Update dp2_state[0]
            val1 = (dp2_state_first[1][i][j] * dp1_state_first[ln]) % modulus
            val1 = (val1 * comb[j + ln][j]) % modulus
            dp2_state_first[0][i + ln][j + ln] = add_mod(dp2_state_first[0][i + ln][j + ln], val1)

            val2 = (dp2_state_first[1][i][j] * dp1_state_second[ln]) % modulus
            val2 = (val2 * comb[j + ln][j]) % modulus
            dp2_state_second[0][i + ln][j + ln] = add_mod(dp2_state_second[0][i + ln][j + ln], val2)

            val3 = (dp2_state_second[1][i][j] * dp1_state_first[ln]) % modulus
            val3 = (val3 * comb[j + ln][j]) % modulus
            dp2_state_second[0][i + ln][j + ln] = add_mod(dp2_state_second[0][i + ln][j + ln], val3)

final_result = dp2_state_second[0][n][m]
final_result = add_mod(final_result, dp2_state_second[1][n][m])
print(final_result)
